subject: Follow-up: IAM evidence for SOC 2 / HIPAA review
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jacob Fernandez <j.fernandez@meditrust.com>, Olga Petrova <olga.it@meditrust.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: IAM evidence for SOC 2 / HIPAA review

Hi Jacob / Olga —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and immediate next steps so we’re all aligned:  

1) Scope: you confirmed the review focuses on our hosted API usage (no on-prem at this stage) and requires HIPAA considerations plus SOC 2 evidence for how we manage identities and admin controls.

2) Primary asks you flagged: SSO/SAML configuration docs, SCIM provisioning evidence (logs or samples), RBAC/admin role matrix, and timeline for SOC 2 Type II artifacts we can share.

3) What we’ll send this week: I’ll coordinate a short IAM packet — SSO diagram + SAML metadata + SCIM provisioning guide and a one-page SOC 2 status summary.

4) Action owners and ETA:
   - Dev: compile SCIM logs sample and step-by-step provisioning guide (ETA: 9/15)
   - Evelyn (Security): SOC 2 summary and RBAC matrix (ETA: 9/16)
   - Me: package artifacts, upload to Drive, and share DocuSign/BAA pointer if needed (ETA: 9/16)

If there’s anything to reprioritize, call it out and we’ll shift. Otherwise I’ll drop the first bundle on Monday.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123
[Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (application/pdf) - 48KB]

From: Jacob Fernandez <j.fernandez@meditrust.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Olga Petrova <olga.it@meditrust.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Sep 2025 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: IAM evidence for SOC 2 / HIPAA review

Hi Marissa —

Appreciate the recap. A couple clarifying items from my side:  

- For SCIM, we need either (A) recent provisioning logs showing successful user create/update/delete flows, or (B) a short demo video of the provisioning flow plus a SCIM payload sample (JSON) we can drop into our security review.
- For SSO/SAML: we need the metadata XML and a list of supported IdPs (Okta/Azure AD/etc.). If you support SP-initiated + IdP-initiated flows, please call that out.
- RBAC: a simple CSV with role -> permissions mapping and a list of which actions are admin-only (e.g., user_invite, token_rotate, view_billing).

Also, do you have a copy of the BAA for Redwood? If not, can you start that process — our procurement team will want to review it in parallel.

If you can drop the SCIM sample/logs first that would unblock our security team quickly.

Thanks,
Jacob
Principal Security Engineer, MediTrust Health
j.fernandez@meditrust.com | +1 617-555-9987

Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Follow-up: IAM evidence for SOC 2 / HIPAA review

Folks — forwarding Jacob’s asks. Short requests below; can we hit these ETAs?

Dev: Jacob prefers the SCIM provisioning logs OR a short payload sample + minimal demo clip. If logs, please redact PII; include timestamps and endpoints (example: POST /scim/v2/Users).
Alex: can you pull the SAML metadata XML and note which IdPs are supported (Okta, Azure AD, Google Workspace). Also include whether SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows are enabled.
Evelyn: please assemble RBAC matrix and the SOC 2 Type II status note (expected date if still in progress). If we have a BAA template, point Marissa to the DocuSign link.

Target: have a zipped packet we can upload by EOD 9/16.

Thanks —
Marissa

Subject: Re: Fwd: Follow-up: IAM evidence for SOC 2 / HIPAA review

Marissa / Jacob —

Uploading the artifacts here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-Redwood-IAM-Evidence (shared with mediTrust security). Packet includes:

- scim-provisioning-guide.docx (walkthrough + provisioning sample)
- scim-example-log.txt (redacted, shows POST /scim/v2/Users 201, PATCH /scim/v2/Users 200, DELETE /scim/v2/Users 204)
- sso-diagram.png (sequence diagram for SAML auth flow)
- saml-metadata.xml (SP metadata, certificate thumbprint included)
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (current status: Type II in progress; testing window Apr–Jun 2025; expected report delivery Oct 2025)

Small SCIM payload sample (redacted) included inline below for immediate parsing by your tooling:

{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "j.fernandez@meditrust.com",
  "name": {"givenName": "Jacob", "familyName": "Fernandez"},
  "emails": [{"value": "j.fernandez@meditrust.com", "primary": true}]
}

Note on RBAC: our admin roles are: super_admin, org_admin, billing_admin, support_operator. I’m attaching a CSV in the Drive with the full mapping (role -> permissions).

Attaching: [Attachment: scim-provisioning-guide.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document) - 56KB], [Attachment: scim-example-log.txt (text/plain) - 12KB]

Date: Thu, 18 Sep 2025 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Follow-up: IAM evidence for SOC 2 / HIPAA review

Marissa / team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround, Dev. I pulled the Drive packet and the SCIM sample works great for our automation tests. Couple of follow-ups before we close the security review:  

- Can you confirm whether SCIM provisioning supports bulk user imports (CSV -> SCIM create flow) or only individual CRUD operations?
- For SAML, can you share the IdP metadata you’ve tested with (Okta integration checklist or Azure AD screenshots are ideal)?
- On the BAA: our procurement team will start review once you share the DocuSign BAA link. Is there a standard Redwood BAA or should we expect a tailored one?

If you can answer the first two items and drop the DocuSign link, we’ll aim to complete the security sign-off by 9/24 and move procurement to finalize contracting.

Regards,
Jacob
Principal Security Engineer, MediTrust Health
